scholarships.name: The “Academic” scholarship
scholarships.description: (bourse “Méritant scolaire”): this scholarship grants a reduction in annual tuition fees, and is for scholarship students (minimum level 1) who achieved an average of over 14/20 the previous year at EM Normandie.

scholarships.name: The “Life’s uncertainties” grant
scholarships.description: (bourse “Aléas de la vie”): this grant, which reduces tuition fees, is for a student who has faced a difficult life event (death of a parent, job loss, illness, etc.) since starting at EM Normandie.

scholarships.name: The “hardship” grant
scholarships.description: (l'“Aide d'urgence”) comes from the School's Hardship Fund, and provides immediate assistance to students facing serious financial difficulty.

scholarships.name: The “mobility - Outgoing” scholarship
scholarships.description: allows scholarship students going abroad to receive a transfer.
